title: Distribution of simplices in the discrete and continuous settings
summary: In this paper, we study the distribution of simplices in both discrete and continuous settings. Let $q$ be an odd prime power, let $Q$ be a nondegenerate quadratic form on $\mathbb F_q^d$, and let $2\leq k\leq d-1$. We prove that every set $E\subset\mathbb F_q^d$ with \[ |E|\geq C_{d,k}q^{β_{d,k}}, \qquad β_{d,k}= \begin{cases} \displaystyle \frac{d+k}{2}-\frac{k-1}{k+1}, & d-k\ \text{even},\\[2mm] \displaystyle \frac{d+k-1}{2}, & d-k\ \text{odd}, \end{cases} \] determines a positive proportion of all ordered nondegenerate $k$-simplex congruence classes.
